Retrieved via Exa 19 July 2026. (AFP.)

SUNDAY 19 JULY:
- The MV Barima, carrying 116 passengers and crew, capsized off Guyana's coast near Iron Punt while travelling from the capital Georgetown to Port Kaituma. It issued a distress call about 11pm Saturday (03:00 GMT Sunday).
- Guyana's PM Mark Phillips told AFP Sunday that 53 people had been rescued; authorities expected to rescue more during daylight hours.
- Rescue involves Guyana's coastguard and private vessels. Public Works Minister Juan Edghill said the ferry carried ~250 life jackets, eight lifeboats and other safety gear; a medical team was dispatched. Circumstances not immediately clear.
- Edghill: "There is an active search and rescue operation that is taking place, and we pray for the safety of all."
